title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2608.30581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used as post hoc explainers of sequential decision-making policies, producing natural-language explanations of why an action was chosen. However, LLMs often generate plausible but incorrect statements, and no existing approach systematically tests whether such explanations are faithful to the underlying environment. Two classic software testing challenges stand in the way: there is no oracle for the correctness of an explanation, and the test inputs, natural language queries about a policy's behavior, lack the structure needed for systematic test case generation. We address both. Probabilistic model checking provides the test oracle, computing exact reference results against which LLM answers are graded automatically. A taxonomy of post hoc query categories structures the input space around the environment-level facts from which policy explanations are composed; test cases generated from it are prioritize

translated_title: 以模型检查作为测试预言的大语言模型事后解释器自动化测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被用作序贯决策策略的事后解释器，生成关于为何选择某个动作的自然语言解释。然而，LLM常常生成看似合理却不正确的陈述，且目前尚无方法能系统性地测试这些解释是否忠实于底层环境。两个经典的软件测试难题阻碍了这一目标的实现：其一是解释的正确性缺乏测试预言，其二是测试输入——关于策略行为的自然语言查询——缺乏系统性测试用例生成所需的结构。本文对这两个问题均给出了解决方案。概率模型检查提供了测试预言，可计算出精确的参考结果，据此对LLM的回答进行自动评分。同时，一个事后查询类别的分类体系围绕环境级别的事实构建了输入空间，而策略解释正是由这些事实组合而成；从中生成的测试用例会被优先……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用概率模型检查作为测试预言，并结合事后查询分类体系来结构化测试输入空间，从而实现对LLM生成的事后解释是否忠实于底层决策环境的自动化测试。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated testing framework that uses probabilistic model checking as a test oracle and structures the input space through a taxonomy of post hoc query categories, enabling systematic verification of whether LLM-generated explanations are faithful to the underlying decision-making environment.
